open.speaker: Kesk
open.text: Tide's out and my paperwork isn't. You look like someone with functioning legs.

offer.speaker: Kesk
offer.text: Mira at the Salt & Sextant owes me a signature. Walk it up the hill?

directions.speaker: Kesk
directions.text: West along the quay, then up. Red roof, salt-bleached door. You'll smell the fire before you see it.

accept.speaker: Kesk
accept.text: Good. Tell her Kesk sent you, and don't let her pour you anything until she's signed.

decline.speaker: Kesk
decline.text: Suit yourself. The ledger isn't going anywhere and neither, apparently, are you.

nag.speaker: Kesk
nag.text: Still here? The signature won't fetch itself. Uphill, red roof.

pay_out.speaker: Kesk
pay_out.text: She signed it. I owe you an apology and eight marks, and you're only getting one of those.

pay_out_end.speaker: Kesk
pay_out_end.text: Eight marks. Spend it back at Mira's, she'll only send it to me as harbour dues anyway.

after_paid.speaker: Kesk
after_paid.text: Clear skies. If the wind turns I'll want a runner again -- you know where I stand.
